statements.t: With the closing of LNA, we have updated the midpoints of our full-year 2026 Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $7.80 billion and $2.48 billion, respectively, as acquisition contributions are anticipated to more than offset lower near-term expectations for our heritage operations.
